sanskrit:
दण्डो दमयतामस्मि नीतिरस्मि जिगीषताम् ।
मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतामहम् ॥ १०-३८॥
iast:
daṇḍo damayatāmasmi nītirasmi jigīṣatām
maunaṃ caivāsmi guhyānāṃ jñānaṃ jñānavatāmaham 10-38
translation: Among punishers I am the Sceptre ; among those who seek victory, I am Statesmanship ; and also among secrets, I am Silence ; and I am the Knowledge among knowers.
